capabilities: Render YouTube and Vimeo links as video cards with thumbnail, title, channel, and duration
Display web or vault images as cards with a full-screen lightbox
Convert selected URLs to cards via context menu or command palette
Arrange cards in horizontal or grid styles across 1, 2, or 3 columns
Copy source links from a button on each card
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; BRAT is offered as a beta installation channel.
problem: Plain video and image links in notes give no visual preview, so media-heavy lists and galleries are hard to scan.

relations.evidence: Video cards with thumbnail, title, channel name, and duration for YouTube and Vimeo.
Video cards with thumbnail, title, channel name, and duration for YouTube and Vimeo.

summary: Media card renderer that converts YouTube, Vimeo, and image links into responsive 1-3 column cards with thumbnails and a lightbox.
